newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt, Paris bourses to combine operations.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt, Paris bourses to combine operations.

text.p: The bourses of Frankfurt and Paris are in close talks to combine cash and futures markets operations, the head of German bourse holding company Deutsche Boerse AG said on Friday.
"We will combine the cash market and the futures markets" of the exchanges, said Deutsche Boerse management board chairman Werner Seifert.
The leader of the Bourses Francaises (SBF) in Paris, Jean-Francious Theodore, said at a securities industry conference in Frankfurt that the link-up was planned for 1998.
The bourses of Frankfurt and Paris had already sought once to combine operations on futures contracts. But Seifert said, "This time it will succeed."
